pages.text: A race's armour shards and sticks make its pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword, as iron ones are made; five shards round an iron ingot make its shield. All are of iron's level and mended with the race's shards.$(br2)$(l)Zerg$() (250 uses): living chitin mends itself, a use every 10 s, three times as fast on creep. The axe bites wood a little faster, the shovel digs creep fast, the hoe makes soil that never dries, the sword poisons one blow in five.

$(l)Terrans$() (375 uses): plain steel, half again as tough; the terran shield held takes blasts better (60 % of their damage).$(br2)$(l)Protoss$() (250 uses): an energy shield takes the first 30 wears of the tool; 30 s after the last it is whole again.

The races' $(l)rounds$(): bone needles (a bone and a zerg shard: 8), toxic needles (4 needles, a spider eye and vespene: 4 — they poison), gauss rounds (an iron nugget, gunpowder and a mineral shard: 8), energy charges (a mineral shard, vespene and a protoss shard: 8). A dispenser fires them straight and fast; so do the turrets.

The races' $(l)turrets$(): the gauss turret (a dispenser, a terran armour slab, redstone, iron), the needle turret (a dispenser, a zerg shard, bone meal, zerg flesh), the photon turret (a dispenser, a protoss shard, minerals, vespene). Set one down and load it with its rounds by right-clicking (empty-handed: how many it has; sneaking, its owner takes it up). It shoots monsters and the wild within 12 blocks it sees — never players nor your own —, and monsters go for it. The needle turret heals on creep; the photon turret's shield comes back when it is left alone. Your base's weapons levels add to its strikes, its race's range research (Hi-Sec Auto Tracking, grooved spines, extended thermal lance) adds 4 blocks of reach; in the command view you select it and order it to fire at a foe.

$(l)Traps$(): the protoss stasis trap (a dispenser, a protoss armour slab, an ender pearl, minerals) shuts a foe within 2.5 blocks in stasis for 5 s, then rests 30 s. Abathur's $(l)toxic nest$() (a zerg shard, gunpowder, a spider eye, zerg flesh) lies flat like the ground and bursts under a foe — harm and poison round it, no block broken — throwing creep about. Foes are monsters, the wild and other players; your units are spared.

The $(l)mineral compass$() (a compass among four mineral shards) points to the nearest mineral field within 128 blocks; the $(l)vespene detector$() (a compass, vespene, redstone) to the nearest vespene vein. The races' chests hold 27 stacks: the zerg chest (eight zerg shards) heals, the terran safe (a chest among eight terran shards) takes blasts, the protoss chest (a chest, minerals, protoss shards) is shielded.

Five of a race's shards make its $(l)boat$(); none breaks on a fall or a knock. The zerg boat heals itself, the terran boat takes half the harm, the protoss boat is a little faster and a shield takes its first blows. The terran boat is a glass cabin: while it stands, it takes the blows meant for its riders. The jump key lifts the protoss boat over the water for 8 s, and sends the zerg boat under it, closed and breathable, its riders spared.

Two shards, as shears are made, make a race's $(l)repair tool$(): it mends a quarter of a block's kept damage a use. The terran one mends what is mechanical (terran armour, metal), the zerg mender what lives (zerg armour, flesh, creep, wood, wool, bone), the protoss restorer brings protoss blocks' shields back.
